description: This file defines the ServerRequestInterface, a PHP interface within the PSR-7 standard for representing server-side HTTP requests. It includes method signatures for accessing request data such as server parameters, cookies, query parameters, uploaded files, parsed body, and attributes, while emphasizing immutability of request objects.

classes.name: ServerRequestInterface
classes.description: An interface that extends RequestInterface, representing an immutable server-side HTTP request with methods to access and modify request meta-data such as server parameters, cookies, query parameters, uploaded files, parsed body, and attributes.

methods.name: getServerParams
methods.description: Retrieve server parameters, typically derived from $_SERVER.

methods.name: getCookieParams
methods.description: Retrieve cookies sent by the client.

methods.name: withCookieParams
methods.description: Return a new instance with updated cookie parameters, maintaining immutability.

methods.name: withQueryParams
methods.description: Return a new instance with updated query parameters.

methods.name: getUploadedFiles
methods.description: Retrieve normalized uploaded file data as a tree of UploadedFileInterface instances.

methods.name: withUploadedFiles
methods.description: Create a new instance with specified uploaded files, maintaining immutability.

methods.name: getParsedBody
methods.description: Retrieve deserialized body parameters, such as $_POST or JSON payload.

methods.name: withParsedBody
methods.description: Return a new instance with specified parsed body data.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieve a single attribute, with an optional default if not set.

methods.name: withAttribute
methods.description: Return a new instance with a specified attribute set.

methods.name: withoutAttribute
methods.description: Return a new instance without a specified attribute.
